stem:
The graph of a relation is shown.

Which statement best describes this graph?

options.label: A
options.text: The graph represents y as a function of x, because each x-value corresponds to exactly one y-value.

options.label: B
options.text: The graph represents y as a function of x, because each x-value corresponds to multiple y-values.

options.label: C
options.text: The graph does not represent y as a function of x, because each x-value corresponds to exactly one y-value.

options.label: D
options.text: The graph does not represent y as a function of x, because each x-value corresponds to multiple y-values.

visual_elements: A graph showing a line decreasing from top left to bottom right passing through quadrants II, I, and IV with x-axis ranging from -6 to 6 and y-axis from -6 to 6.
